verdict.rationale: Kling's own marketing says it can generate multiple versions at once, batch-produce videos, and generate Skill outputs in parallel, with MCP/CLI access for running at scale. That is first-party batch generation, but it is described only at a high level, so the depth of the bulk capability is unproven. Missing for 10: documented batch API or CLI semantics (limits, job management), bulk operations on existing items (edit, delete, download, re-run), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Generate multiple versions at once to test styles, batch-produce videos, and automate the entire production process.
Use dedicated Skills to create storyboards, posters, e-commerce assets, and more—all generated in parallel.
MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale
